name: Within
submission_name: Within: Agent spending. Within your rules.
descriptor: A policy wallet for AI agents on XRPL.
positioning: Within gives AI agents a wallet URL for policy-controlled payments on XRPL.
introduction: Within gives AI agents a wallet URL for policy-controlled payments on XRPL. The wallet checks requests before signing. Eligible payments auto-sign; eligible larger payments wait for approval in the Ledger Speculos emulator.

typography.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

usage.mono: Tagline in terminal panels, labels, amounts, hashes, and status

naming_rules.suffixes: Use component names as descriptions, not additional brands.
naming_rules.continuity: Use historical component names only when identifying demo segments or evidence; the brand subtitle is the tagline.

usage_rules.clear_space: At least one central-dot diameter around the complete logo.
usage_rules.cobalt_field: Use white brackets with a navy dot on a solid cobalt field.
usage_rules.small_sizes: Prefer a high-contrast monochrome mark; the board's 16px navy sample is not a validated favicon.
usage_rules.ui_state: Cobalt is a brand color, not proof that a transaction is approved.
usage_rules.contrast: Use ink on pale, white on ink or shell, white on cobalt, and link_on_dark for small links on navy.
